item.subject: Mathematics
item.stem: One of these angles is a right angle. Which one?
item.figure_description:
Four angles labeled A, B, C, and D:
- Option A shows two connected line segments meeting at an apex pointing upward, one segment sloping down to the left at roughly 45° and the other sloping down to the right at roughly 45°.
- Option B shows two connected line segments meeting at a bottom vertex, one extending nearly vertically upward and the other slanting upward and to the right, forming an angle of approximately 25°.
- Option C shows two connected line segments meeting at a top vertex, one extending vertically downward and the other slanting downward and to the left, forming an angle of approximately 20°.
- Option D shows two connected line segments meeting at a bottom vertex, one slanting downward to the right and the other extending horizontally to the right, forming an angle of approximately 120°.
item.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.

guessing.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's guessing (lower asymptote) parameter c: the probability that a student of very low ability answers it correctly, such as by guessing among the options? Choose the value closest to it.
